_about: THE duration formats (round f30; the user, 2026-10-21: "Showing 60 min and 120 min is long, 1 h and 2 h is better.
This applies everywhere in the UI"). One formatter per platform: Android core/Durations.kt, Mac
spikes/widgets-macos/Shared/Durations.swift; both are tested against this file (DurationsTest, -settingsselftest).
tools/check rule 'durations' fails on a duration formatted by hand anywhere else.
text    every duration in words and settings: notifications, sheets, settings presets, history, menus.
under 60 min 'N min'; from 60 whole hours 'N h', else 'N h M min' (no days).
compact the card's convention (renderer: treatment labels, the last-treatment slot, 'Xm left' badges):
'Nm', 'Nh', 'Nh Mm'; from 6 h whole hours only; from 48 h whole days.
whole   one unit, rounded down: minutes, from 60 min hours, from 24 h days (the sensor-life badge, warm-up).
parse   typed minutes (Mute..., custom values): a number of minutes, or hours with h, or h:mm; null = not a duration.
Spanish ('es') uses the same unit symbols with spaces (SI style): '1 h 30 min'; Mac is English only.
